exceptions.reason: Stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested brace patterns. The Markdown gate expands only globs the repository itself declares: markdownlint-cli2's configuration and the style exclusions in verify.mjs settings. A hostile pattern would have to be committed, and it would only exhaust that repository's own lint run. No fixed release exists: braces 3.0.3, micromatch 4.0.8 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3 are the latest.

max-stale handling can disclose a cached response to another user of a shared cache. Astro 7.3.5 uses the package only in dist/assets/build/remote.js, to decide whether a remote image fetched during the static build may be reused from the build cache. A build serves no users, so no response can cross users. No fixed release exists: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is the latest, and astro 7.3.5 requires ^4.2.0.
